patch_description: Crossover combining the strongest elements from the top-performing variants: (1) the current program's two-pass RTS core (best correlation 0.89 / noise reduction 0.55), (2) the inspiration's convergence-gated third RTS refinement pass with geometrically decaying Q (which improved slope changes and false reversals), and (3) the velocity-limited reconstruction from the second prior program (best slope_changes 15.8 / false_reversals 12.0), which clamps sub-noise per-step displacements using the smoothed velocity state to suppress spurious reversals without lagging genuine trends. The pipeline: MAD-based noise statistics → RTS pass 1 → RTS refinement (Q/4) → gated RTS pass 3 (Q/16, skipped if converged) → velocity-limited reconstruction blended 80/20 with the unclamped estimate → zero-phase bilateral one-pole damper. This preserves tracking accuracy and noise reduction while targeting the slope-change and false-reversal penalties where the current program loses points.
